patch_meaning: Exporter and native validator no longer require q_norm and k_norm widths to be identical.
q_norm is validated against q projection rows.
k_norm is validated independently against q projection rows and k projection rows.

Norm widths must remain rank-1, head-dim aligned, not wider than q projection rows, must tile q projection rows, and must be compatible with the corresponding projection rows in either divisor direction.
The real phone failure shape, q_norm [512] with k_norm [256], is covered by exporter and native regression tests.
Validation remains fail-closed for incompatible norm widths, dtype/shape/range errors, and missing runtime compute body.
